inventory.name: [NopalCyber] File in the Root of Public Dir

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] File in the Root of Public Dir
native_rule.s1ql:
"(
  event.category = 'Process'
  AND tgt.process.cmdline RegExp ':\\Users\\Public\\[0-9A-Za-z]{1,20}\.
  (
    exe|dll|ocx|vbs|vbe|wsf|jar|jse|bat|wpl|dat|bin|rtf|png|jpg
  )
  '
  AND NOT
  (
    tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'display'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'convert'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'text'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'test'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Office'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'SweepDownloaded'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Level Platforms'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'ScreenShot'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Bginfo'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Microsoft'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'VMware'
    OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'Print'
  )
  AND NOT
  (
    src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Level Platforms'
  )
)
OR
(
  event.category = 'File'
  AND tgt.file.path RegExp ':\\Users\\Public\\[0-9A-Za-z]{1,20}\.
  (
    exe|dll|ocx|txt|vbs|vbe|wsf|jar|jse|bat|wpl|bin|rtf|png|jpg
  )
  $'
  AND NOT
  (
    tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'display'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'convert'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'text'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'test'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Office'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'SweepDownloaded'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Level Platforms'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'ScreenShot'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Bginfo'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Microsoft'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'VMware'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Print'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'Level Platforms'
    OR tgt.file.path contains:anycase 'install'
  )
  AND NOT
  (
    src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'msiexec.exe'
    OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Kaseya'
  )
)"
